define_random_variable_mean: create a random variable with a Normal(0,1) prior distribution using the bm.random_variable decorator
define_random_variable_category: create a Categorical random variable that chooses from categories with ratio 1:3:4 using bm.random_variable
define_random_variable_mixed: create a composed random variable that samples from a Normal distribution using mean and category
test_gmm_to_dot: test the GaussianMixtureModel by generating a DOT graph representation of the inference model using BMGInference
generate_dot_graph: generate a DOT graph of the probabilistic model by calling BMGInference().to_dot with queries and observations
